note: Run each prompt with the skill and with the previous version or no skill. Grade every assertion as pass or fail from the transcript and the resulting diff. A good assertion fails without the skill. should_trigger prompts must load this skill. should_not_trigger prompts are near misses that belong to another skill and must not load this one.

evals.prompt: We are launching product pages in English and Spanish, and selling in USD and EUR. What do we need to do for SEO?
assertions: Asks or states the business model before choosing markup
Requires a distinct URL per currency and rejects a cookie or IP currency toggle
Notes the template locales are language-only and a currency market needs region locales or a market segment
Chooses Product and Offer for a direct seller and does not put Product markup on category pages
Says price and availability in JSON-LD come from the same source as the visible price
Gives an out-of-stock and discontinued policy with 404 or 410 or a real successor redirect
Does not claim rankings or rich results as outcomes

should_trigger: We are launching product pages in English and Spanish and selling in USD and EUR. What do we need to do for SEO?
Should filtered category URLs like /shoes?color=red&size=9 be indexable?
What do we do with a discontinued product page that still gets backlinks?

How should we set up a Google Merchant Center feed alongside the site so prices match?
Do we need a separate URL for each currency, or can we switch currency with a cookie?
Which product URLs should go in the sitemap for a store with seasonal items?
